subset: celltype_broad == CD8 T; retain all 53538 selected cells and all source RNA/ADT/HTO assays and TCR metadata
normalization: RNA LogNormalize, scale factor10000; vst3000 variable genes, excluding mitochondrial, ribosomal, variable receptor and selected sex-linked nuisance genes; ScaleData
reduction: PCA50; Harmony on pair_id, first30 PCs, max20 iterations; UMAP on30 Harmony dimensions, n_neighbors30, min_dist0.3
clustering: Louvain algorithm1, resolution0.5, CD8 SNN; random seed222633
markers: Seurat FindAllMarkers, Wilcoxon/limma implementation, only.posTRUE, min.pct0.1, logfc.threshold0.25; balanced subsampling max1500 cells per comparison group for marker testing; original full-cell cluster expression summaries retained
annotation: canonical lineage/state markers, complete cluster markers, UCell programs, ADT phenotype and TCR support; use Naive/Tcm/Tem/Teff nomenclature with supported finer states; no forced S2/S3 or Tex label
existing_file_policy: source immutable; targets were absent at audit; final creation requires absent target; no previous file deletion, overwrite or movement
